ghi_chu: Thử cổng PlenX AI (Veo 3.1 Lite) cho QC kể chuyện dài 2–3' (anh 21/10/2026: "dựng 1 video ad story telling 2-3' để xem api plex mới thế nào… phải qua studio chuẩn"). Phim hàng chờ Poor Guests? Wrong Billionaires. (NetShort 107547) — chỉ dựng xem chất lượng, KHÔNG lên camp. Kể ngôi thứ nhất (Shalini), 19 cảnh × 8s + thẻ cuối.

phim.nhan_vat: SHALINI = Indian woman in her 50s, hair tied back, pink embroidered cotton kurta (narrator); MUKESH = her husband, Indian man in his 60s, balding, beige polo shirt, sits in a wheelchair after a stroke; MS. KAPOOR = arrogant resort manager, Indian woman early 30s, long black wavy hair, red blazer and red skirt, name badge; PEARL GUEST = wealthy Indian woman 40s, royal blue dress, pearl necklace, big hoop earrings; ARJUN = their son, Indian man late 30s, dark suit, magenta shirt, phone in hand

boi_canh.mo_ta: Luxury Indian seaside resort: marble lobby with chandeliers and white floral arches, polished reception desk, palm-lined driveway with a gate, monsoon rain outside, sunset suite balcony over the sea

canh.loi: They threw us out like beggars. They had no idea we own this whole resort chain.
canh.anh: Marble resort lobby with chandeliers. MS. KAPOOR in red blazer points sharply toward the exit; SHALINI in pink kurta stands beside MUKESH in his wheelchair; elegant guests stare.
canh.dong: MS. KAPOOR jabs her finger at the door, SHALINI grips the wheelchair handles; fast push-in on SHALINI's hurt face.

canh.loi: My husband Mukesh had a stroke last year. I promised him one quiet week by the sea.
canh.anh: Palm-lined resort driveway in soft morning light. SHALINI pushes MUKESH in his wheelchair, a small pink suitcase on his lap, both smiling gently.
canh.dong: SHALINI wheels MUKESH slowly toward the resort entrance; gentle tracking shot.

canh.loi: We came simply dressed. No driver, no titles. Just two old people wanting some peace.
canh.anh: Polished reception desk. SHALINI places a plain cotton bag on the counter; MUKESH waits in his wheelchair; a receptionist in a white shirt looks them over.
canh.dong: SHALINI smiles politely and slides her phone with the booking across the counter; slow slide.

canh.loi: Then the manager, Ms. Kapoor, looked at my cotton kurta and started laughing.
canh.anh: Close on MS. KAPOOR in red blazer, smirking, eyes running up and down SHALINI's simple kurta.
canh.dong: MS. KAPOOR covers a mocking laugh with her hand; handheld close-up.

canh.loi: She said people like us belong in a cheap hostel, not in her five star resort.
canh.anh: MS. KAPOOR waves her hand dismissively at SHALINI and MUKESH; marble lobby behind, guests turning to look.
canh.dong: MS. KAPOOR flicks her hand toward the door; SHALINI lowers her eyes; slow lateral move.

canh.loi: A rich guest in pearls joined in. She called us frauds in front of everyone.
canh.anh: PEARL GUEST in royal blue dress and pearl necklace laughs and points; guests behind her raise phones to film.
canh.dong: PEARL GUEST points and laughs, phones lift around her; quick push-in.

canh.loi: I showed her our booking. Ms. Kapoor tore it in half without even reading it.
canh.anh: Close on hands: MS. KAPOOR rips a printed booking confirmation in two over the reception desk.
canh.dong: The paper tears and the halves drift to the marble floor; slow-motion feel.

canh.loi: Then she accused us of stealing a guest's gold bracelet.
canh.anh: MS. KAPOOR holds up a gold bracelet accusingly; a security guard in uniform walks toward SHALINI.
canh.dong: MS. KAPOOR lifts the bracelet high, the guard steps in; tense handheld.

canh.loi: Security grabbed my husband's wheelchair. Mukesh couldn't even speak to defend himself.
canh.anh: A security guard holds MUKESH's wheelchair handles; MUKESH looks frightened; SHALINI reaches out toward him.
canh.dong: The guard pulls the wheelchair back, SHALINI reaches after it; camera follows.

canh.loi: When I begged them to stop, she shoved me aside like I was nothing.
canh.anh: MS. KAPOOR pushes SHALINI aside with her arm; SHALINI stumbles against a floral arch, guests gasp.
canh.dong: SHALINI stumbles back, steadies herself on the arch; quick whip pan.

canh.loi: Everyone laughed. Someone said poor people should learn their place.
canh.anh: Wide shot of the lobby: elegant guests laughing and filming; SHALINI kneels beside MUKESH's wheelchair holding his hand.
canh.dong: Laughing guests surround them; slow crane down to SHALINI holding MUKESH's hand.

canh.loi: They dragged our suitcase to the gate and tossed it out into the rain.
canh.anh: Resort gate in heavy monsoon rain; the small pink suitcase lies on the wet driveway; SHALINI shields MUKESH with her scarf.
canh.dong: Rain pours, SHALINI pulls her scarf over MUKESH; wide static then slow push.

canh.loi: So I made one phone call. Just one.
canh.anh: Under the gate awning, rain behind her, SHALINI holds an old phone to her ear, face suddenly calm and determined.
canh.dong: SHALINI lifts the phone, her expression hardens; slow push-in.

canh.loi: Twenty minutes later, three black cars rolled up the drive.
canh.anh: Three black luxury sedans with headlights on roll up the wet palm-lined driveway; resort staff freeze at the entrance.
canh.dong: The cars glide in one after another, water spraying; low tracking shot.

canh.loi: Out stepped our son, Arjun Saxena. The man who owns this resort, and forty more.
canh.anh: ARJUN in dark suit and magenta shirt steps out of the lead car, bodyguards with umbrellas; staff bow nervously.
canh.dong: ARJUN steps out and buttons his jacket, umbrellas open around him; hero low angle push.

canh.loi: Ms. Kapoor's smile froze. The bracelet slipped right out of her fingers.
canh.anh: Close on MS. KAPOOR in red blazer, color draining from her face; the gold bracelet falls from her hand.
canh.dong: Her smile collapses and the bracelet drops; slow-motion close-up.

canh.loi: The guest in pearls tried to hide. Her husband's company works for our family.
canh.anh: PEARL GUEST turns away pale, clutching her pearl necklace; her husband beside her looks stunned at ARJUN.
canh.dong: PEARL GUEST backs away behind a pillar; quick lateral reveal.

canh.loi: Arjun knelt beside his father, then looked at the staff and said one word. Out.
canh.anh: ARJUN kneels next to MUKESH's wheelchair holding his father's hand, then looks up coldly at MS. KAPOOR.
canh.dong: ARJUN squeezes his father's hand, rises, and stares down MS. KAPOOR; slow crane up.

canh.loi: Some lessons can't be bought with money. And karma always collects with interest.
canh.anh: Sunset suite balcony over the sea: SHALINI and MUKESH sit together, peaceful and smiling, warm golden light.
canh.dong: SHALINI rests her head on MUKESH's shoulder as the sun sets; slow pull back.
